def _fmt(v: float, unit: str = "") -> str:
    if np.isnan(v):
        return "  N/A  "
    return f"{v:7.3f}{unit}"


def _improvement(gold: float, model: float, higher_is_better: bool = False) -> str:
    if np.isnan(gold) or np.isnan(model):
        return "   N/A  "
    if higher_is_better:
        diff_pp = (model - gold) * 100
        return f"+{diff_pp:.1f} pp" if diff_pp >= 0 else f"{diff_pp:.1f} pp"
    else:
        pct = (model - gold) / (abs(gold) + 1e-12) * 100
        return f"{pct:+.1f}%"


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Compute all 5 contest metrics for Goldstein vs FiLMUNet.",
        formatter_class=argparse.ArgumentDefaultsHelpFormatter,
    )
    p.add_argument("--checkpoint", required=True,
                   help="Path to FiLMUNet checkpoint (.pt).")
    p.add_argument("--pairs_dir", required=True,
                   help="Root directory of processed pair subdirectories.")
    p.add_argument("--triplets_manifest", required=True,
                   help="Parquet file with triplet definitions.")
    p.add_argument("--out_dir", default="experiments/enhanced/outputs",
                   help="Output directory for CSV and figures.")
    p.add_argument("--tile_size", type=int, default=256)
    p.add_argument("--stride",    type=int, default=128)
    p.add_argument("--test_frac", type=float, default=0.15,
                   help="Fraction of pairs to use as the held-out test set.")
    p.add_argument("--skip_inference", action="store_true",
                   help="Skip model inference (re-use existing ifg_film_unet.tif).")
    p.add_argument("--force_inference", action="store_true",
                   help="Force overwrite existing ifg_film_unet.tif (re-run inference).")
    p.add_argument("--skip_snaphu_metrics", action="store_true",
                   help="Skip metrics 2/3/4 that require unw_phase.tif.")
    p.add_argument("--test_only", action="store_true",
                   help="Evaluate on test split only (last --test_frac pairs by date).")
    p.add_argument("--device", default=None,
                   help="PyTorch device string (default: cuda if available).")
    return p.parse_args()


def main() -> None:
    args = parse_args()

    out_dir = Path(args.out_dir)
    fig_dir = out_dir / "figures"
    fig_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    # ── Timestamp-based eval tag ────────────────────────────────────────────
    eval_ts    = datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M')
    chkpt_stem = Path(args.checkpoint).stem   # e.g. "raw2gold_20260319_2139_final"
    eval_tag   = f"eval_{chkpt_stem}_{eval_ts}"

    log_path = Path("logs") / f"{eval_tag}.log"
    log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    file_handler = logging.FileHandler(log_path)
    file_handler.setFormatter(logging.Formatter("%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(message)s"))
    logging.getLogger().addHandler(file_handler)
    log.info("Eval tag: %s | Log: %s", eval_tag, log_path)

    device = torch.device(
        args.device if args.device else ("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    )
    log.info("Using device: %s", device)

    # ── Discover pairs ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    pairs_dir = Path(args.pairs_dir)
    all_pairs = _discover_pairs(pairs_dir)
    if not all_pairs:
        log.error("No pairs with ifg_goldstein.tif found in %s", pairs_dir)
        sys.exit(1)

    eval_pairs = _temporal_split_test(all_pairs, args.test_frac) if args.test_only \
                 else all_pairs
    log.info("Evaluating on %d pairs (%s)", len(eval_pairs),
             "test split" if args.test_only else "all pairs")

    # ── Load triplets manifest ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    triplets_path = Path(args.triplets_manifest)
    if triplets_path.exists():
        triplets_df = pd.read_parquet(triplets_path)
        log.info("Loaded %d triplets from %s", len(triplets_df), triplets_path)
    else:
        log.warning("Triplets manifest not found: %s — metric 1 will be N/A", triplets_path)
        triplets_df = pd.DataFrame()

    # ── FiLMUNet inference ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if not args.skip_inference:
        model = _load_model(args.checkpoint, device)
        n_infer = 0
        for i, pd_dir in enumerate(eval_pairs):
            if (pd_dir / "ifg_film_unet.tif").exists() and not args.force_inference:
                log.info("[%d/%d] Skipping (ifg_film_unet.tif exists): %s",
                         i + 1, len(eval_pairs), pd_dir.name)
                continue
            log.info("[%d/%d] Inference: %s", i + 1, len(eval_pairs), pd_dir.name)
            try:
                denoised, log_var = run_inference_on_pair(
                    model, pd_dir, device, args.tile_size, args.stride
                )
                save_inference_outputs(pd_dir, denoised, log_var)
                n_infer += 1
            except Exception as e:
                log.error("Inference failed for %s: %s", pd_dir.name, e)
        log.info("Inference complete: %d new outputs written.", n_infer)

    # ── Metric 1: Triplet closure ───────────────────────────────────────────
    # Use ALL processed pairs so triplets can be matched.
    # FiLMUNet uses Goldstein as fallback for pairs without inference output.
    gold_closure  = compute_closure_metrics(
        all_pairs, triplets_df, "goldstein")
    model_closure = compute_closure_metrics(
        all_pairs, triplets_df, "film_unet", fallback_method="goldstein")

    # Per-triplet error lists for histogram
    gold_errors_list  = _collect_triplet_errors_list(
        all_pairs, triplets_df, "goldstein")
    model_errors_list = _collect_triplet_errors_list(
        all_pairs, triplets_df, "film_unet", fallback_method="goldstein")

    # ── Metrics 2 & 3 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # Per-pair coherence stats (shared for both methods)
    pair_stats = collect_pair_stats(eval_pairs, "goldstein", args.skip_snaphu_metrics)

    if not args.skip_snaphu_metrics:
        # Metric 2: mean unwrap success rate across pairs
        uwr_list = [r["unwrap_success_rate"] for r in pair_stats
                    if "unwrap_success_rate" in r]
        gold_uwr  = float(np.mean(uwr_list)) if uwr_list else float("nan")
        model_uwr = float("nan")  # Film UNet uses goldstein phase for unwrapping currently
    else:
        gold_uwr  = float("nan")
        model_uwr = float("nan")

    # Metric 3: usable pairs fraction (back-fill closure from aggregate)
    if gold_errors_list:
        med_gold_closure  = float(np.median(gold_errors_list))
        med_model_closure = float(np.median(model_errors_list)) if model_errors_list \
                            else float("nan")
        for r in pair_stats:
            r.setdefault("median_closure_rad", med_gold_closure)
    else:
        med_gold_closure  = float("nan")
        med_model_closure = float("nan")

    # Use coherence-only gate when no closure data is available
    closure_thresh = 0.5 if not np.isnan(med_gold_closure) else float("inf")
    gold_usable = usable_pairs_fraction(pair_stats, closure_threshold_rad=closure_thresh)

    model_pair_stats = [dict(r) for r in pair_stats]
    if not np.isnan(med_model_closure):
        for r in model_pair_stats:
            r["median_closure_rad"] = med_model_closure
    m_closure_thresh = 0.5 if not np.isnan(med_model_closure) else float("inf")
    model_usable = usable_pairs_fraction(model_pair_stats, closure_threshold_rad=m_closure_thresh)

    # ── Metric 4: DEM NMAD ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # Requires a reference DEM — not available in current setup
    gold_nmad  = float("nan")
    model_nmad = float("nan")

    # ── Metric 5: Temporal consistency ─────────────────────────────────────
    # Use all pairs for an overconstrained SBAS system; FiLMUNet falls back
    # to Goldstein for pairs without model outputs.
    gold_temporal  = compute_temporal_residual(all_pairs, "goldstein")
    model_temporal = compute_temporal_residual(all_pairs, "film_unet")

    # ── Assemble results ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    metrics = {
        "triplet_closure_rad":    (gold_closure["median_rad"],  model_closure["median_rad"]),
        "unwrap_success_rate":    (gold_uwr,                    model_uwr),
        "usable_pairs_fraction":  (gold_usable,                 model_usable),
        "dem_nmad_m":             (gold_nmad,                   model_nmad),
        "temporal_residual_rad":  (gold_temporal,               model_temporal),
    }
    higher_is_better = {
        "triplet_closure_rad":    False,
        "unwrap_success_rate":    True,
        "usable_pairs_fraction":  True,
        "dem_nmad_m":             False,
        "temporal_residual_rad":  False,
    }
    labels = {
        "triplet_closure_rad":    "Triplet Closure Error (rad)",
        "unwrap_success_rate":    "Unwrap Success Rate",
        "usable_pairs_fraction":  "Usable Pairs Fraction",
        "dem_nmad_m":             "DEM NMAD (m)",
        "temporal_residual_rad":  "Temporal Residual (rad)",
    }

    # ── Print summary ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    print("\n" + "=" * 62)
    print("=== Contest Metric Comparison ===")
    print("=" * 62)
    print(f"{'Metric':<34} {'Goldstein':>10} {'FiLMUNet':>10} {'Improvement':>12}")
    print("-" * 62)
    for key, (g, m) in metrics.items():
        hib = higher_is_better[key]
        note = ""
        if np.isnan(g) and np.isnan(m):
            note = "  ← N/A (unw_phase.tif not found)" if key in (
                "unwrap_success_rate", "dem_nmad_m") else ""
        print(f"{labels[key]:<34} {_fmt(g):>10} {_fmt(m):>10} {_improvement(g, m, hib):>12}{note}")
    print("=" * 62)

    if args.skip_snaphu_metrics:
        print("Note: Metrics 2/3/4 require unw_phase.tif — run scripts/unwrap_snaphu.py first.")
    print(f"Triplets matched: {gold_closure['n_triplets']} (goldstein), "
          f"{model_closure['n_triplets']} (film_unet)")
    if gold_closure["n_triplets"] == 0:
        print("Warning: 0 complete triplets found in processed pairs.")
        print("  The 100 processed pairs do not form any complete triplet (a→b, b→c, a→c).")
        print("  To compute Metric 1, run preprocess_pairs.py on additional pairs that")
        print("  complete triplets — or run eval without --test_only to use all pairs.")
    print()

    # ── Save CSV ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    rows = []
    for key, (g, m) in metrics.items():
        hib = higher_is_better[key]
        rows.append({"metric": labels[key], "method": "goldstein", "value": g})
        rows.append({"metric": labels[key], "method": "film_unet",  "value": m})
        impv = float("nan")
        if not (np.isnan(g) or np.isnan(m)):
            impv = (m - g) / (abs(g) + 1e-12) * 100 if not hib \
                   else (m - g) * 100
        rows.append({"metric": labels[key], "method": "improvement_pct", "value": impv})

    csv_path = out_dir / f"metrics_{eval_tag}.csv"
    pd.DataFrame(rows).to_csv(csv_path, index=False)
    log.info("Saved %s", csv_path)

    # ── Figures ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    _save_closure_histogram(
        gold_errors_list,
        model_errors_list,
        fig_dir / f"{eval_tag}_closure_histogram.png",
    )
    _save_phase_comparison(eval_pairs, fig_dir / f"{eval_tag}_phase_comparison.png")
    _save_temporal_residual_bar(
        gold_temporal,
        model_temporal,
        fig_dir / f"{eval_tag}_temporal_residual_bar.png",
    )

    print(f"Outputs written to: {out_dir}/")
    print(f"  metrics_{eval_tag}.csv")
    print(f"  figures/{eval_tag}_closure_histogram.png")
    print(f"  figures/{eval_tag}_phase_comparison.png")
    print(f"  figures/{eval_tag}_temporal_residual_bar.png")

## Summary

- **M5 bug fix** (`src/evaluation/closure_metrics.py`): `temporal_consistency_residual()` was reporting the *weighted* residual `‖W(phi − Ax*)‖₂`, inflating FiLMUNet M5 by ~3000× when `log_var < 0`. Now reports the unweighted phase-space residual `‖phi − Ax*‖₂` — weights still improve SBAS inversion but the metric stays in radians and is comparable between methods.
- **Closure loss fix** (`experiments/enhanced/train_film_unet.py`): Added `--triplets_manifest` CLI flag. Without it, `triplet_loader is None` and the entire closure loss branch was silently skipped (`val_closure = 0.0000` every epoch). Retraining with this flag now required.
- **Weight normalization** (`eval/compute_metrics.py`): Added `weights /= weights.mean()` before SBAS inversion to prevent residual scale inflation.
- **New script** (`scripts/assess_coreg_quality.py`): Retroactive coherence QC on all processed pairs, outputs `data/manifests/coreg_quality.csv`.
- **Training ablation flags**: `--loss_n2n/unc/closure/temporal/grad`, `--zero_film`, `--run_name`, saves `training_summary.json` per run.

## Metric Impact (Mar 21 eval, 224 pairs)

| Metric | Goldstein | FiLMUNet | Status |
|--------|-----------|----------|--------|
| M1 Triplet Closure | 1.018 rad | 1.021 rad | ≈ equal (closure loss was off — retrain pending) |
| M5 Temporal Residual | 1.158 rad | **0.653 rad** | **-43.6% ✓** (target: -20%) |

## Next step
Launch retrain with `--triplets_manifest data/manifests/hawaii_triplets_strict.parquet` to activate closure loss → expect M1 improvement.

Closes #13
EOF
)"

### Task B — Uncertainty-weighted SNAPHU tile cost (stretch goal)

- Re-run SNAPHU on pairs where `ifg_film_unet.tif` exists

### Task C — Document in paper

- Report M2/M3 comparison: SNAPHU with coherence vs SNAPHU with FiLMUNet uncertainty

## Success Criterion

    80→    Loads preprocessed interferogram tiles for FiLMUNet training.

   117→    def _index_pair(self, pair_dir: Path) -> None:
   118→        ifg_path = pair_dir / "ifg_goldstein.tif"
   119→        coh_path = pair_dir / "coherence.tif"
   120→        if not ifg_path.exists() or not coh_path.exists():
   121→            return
   122→        try:
   123→            import rasterio
   124→            with rasterio.open(coh_path) as src:
   125→                H, W = src.height, src.width
   126→        except Exception:
   127→            return
   128→        T = self.tile_size
   129→        S = self.stride
   130→        for r in range(0, H - T + 1, S):

   134→    def _load_tile(self, pair_dir: Path, r: int, c: int):
   135→        import rasterio
   136→        T = self.tile_size
   137→        window = rasterio.windows.Window(c, r, T, T)
   138→
   139→        # Goldstein (pseudo-clean target)
   140→        with rasterio.open(pair_dir / "ifg_goldstein.tif") as src:
   141→            data = src.read(window=window)
   142→            if data.shape[0] == 1:
   143→                cplx = data[0].astype(np.complex64)
   144→                re_gold, im_gold = cplx.real, cplx.imag
   145→            else:
   146→                re_gold, im_gold = data[0].astype(np.float32), data[1].astype(np.float32)
   147→
   148→        # Raw (noisy input) — fallback to Goldstein if missing
   149→        raw_path = pair_dir / "ifg_raw.tif"
   150→        if raw_path.exists():
   151→            with rasterio.open(raw_path) as src:
   152→                data = src.read(window=window)
   153→                if data.shape[0] == 1:
   154→                    cplx = data[0].astype(np.complex64)
   155→                    re_raw, im_raw = cplx.real, cplx.imag
   156→                else:
   157→                    re_raw, im_raw = data[0].astype(np.float32), data[1].astype(np.float32)
   158→        else:
   159→            re_raw, im_raw = re_gold, im_gold
   160→
   161→        with rasterio.open(pair_dir / "coherence.tif") as src:
   162→            coh = src.read(1, window=window).astype(np.float32)
   163→
   164→        # Guard against NaN/Inf from edge pixels or masked nodata
   165→        re_raw  = np.nan_to_num(re_raw,  nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
   166→        im_raw  = np.nan_to_num(im_raw,  nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
   167→        re_gold = np.nan_to_num(re_gold, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
   168→        im_gold = np.nan_to_num(im_gold, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
   169→        coh     = np.nan_to_num(coh,     nan=0.0, posinf=1.0, neginf=0.0)
   170→
   171→        return re_raw, im_raw, re_gold, im_gold, coh

   211→    @staticmethod
   212→    def _augment(re_raw, im_raw, re_gold, im_gold, coh):
   213→        """Physically-safe augmentations: rotations, flips, global phase offset."""
   214→        k = random.randint(0, 3)
   215→        re_raw  = np.rot90(re_raw,  k).copy()
   216→        im_raw  = np.rot90(im_raw,  k).copy()
   217→        re_gold = np.rot90(re_gold, k).copy()
   218→        im_gold = np.rot90(im_gold, k).copy()
   219→        coh     = np.rot90(coh,     k).copy()
   220→        if random.random() > 0.5:
   221→            re_raw  = np.fliplr(re_raw).copy()
   222→            im_raw  = np.fliplr(im_raw).copy()
   223→            re_gold = np.fliplr(re_gold).copy()
   224→            im_gold = np.fliplr(im_gold).copy()
   225→            coh     = np.fliplr(coh).copy()
   226→        # Global phase offset applied consistently to both raw and gold
   227→        phi_offset = random.uniform(-np.pi, np.pi)
   228→        cos_o, sin_o = np.cos(phi_offset), np.sin(phi_offset)
   229→        re_raw_new  = re_raw  * cos_o - im_raw  * sin_o
   230→        im_raw_new  = re_raw  * sin_o + im_raw  * cos_o
   231→        re_gold_new = re_gold * cos_o - im_gold * sin_o
   232→        im_gold_new = re_gold * sin_o + im_gold * cos_o
   233→        # Amplitude jitter ±10%
   234→        scale = random.uniform(0.9, 1.1)
   235→        return re_raw_new * scale, im_raw_new * scale, re_gold_new * scale, im_gold_new * scale, coh

   272→def _pair_key(row, edge: str) -> str:
   273→    """Build pair dir name (id_ref__id_sec) from triplet row for edge 'ij', 'jk', or 'ik'.
   274→
   275→    Triplet manifest columns: id_a, id_b, id_c.
   276→    Edge mapping: ij=a→b, jk=b→c, ik=a→c  (double-underscore separator, matches dir names).
   277→    """
   278→    _edge_map = {"ij": ("id_a", "id_b"), "jk": ("id_b", "id_c"), "ik": ("id_a", "id_c")}
   279→    col_ref, col_sec = _edge_map[edge]
   280→    return f"{row[col_ref]}__{row[col_sec]}"

   283→class TripletTileDataset(Dataset):
   284→    """
   285→    Each item is a spatially-aligned tile from all 3 pairs of a closure triplet.
   286→    Enables the closure loss in run_epoch().
   287→
   288→    triplets_df : DataFrame with columns id_ref_ij, id_sec_ij,
   289→                  id_ref_jk, id_sec_jk, id_ref_ik, id_sec_ik
   290→    pair_dir_map: {pair_id -> Path} built from discover_pair_dirs()
   291→    """
   292→
   293→    def __init__(
   294→        self,
   295→        triplets_df: pd.DataFrame,
   296→        pair_dir_map: Dict[str, Path],
   297→        tile_size: int = 256,
   298→        stride: int = 128,
   299→        min_coherence: float = 0.15,
   300→    ):
   301→        self.tile_size = tile_size
   302→        self.min_coherence = min_coherence
   303→        self.tiles: List[Tuple] = []  # (dir_ij, dir_jk, dir_ik, r, c)
   304→
   305→        for _, row in triplets_df.iterrows():
   306→            # Try canonical order first; fall back to reversed (ref/sec swapped)
   307→            _edge_rev = {"ij": ("id_b", "id_a"), "jk": ("id_c", "id_b"), "ik": ("id_c", "id_a")}
   308→            def _lookup(edge):
   309→                key = _pair_key(row, edge)
   310→                if key in pair_dir_map:
   311→                    return pair_dir_map[key]
   312→                cols = _edge_rev[edge]
   313→                rev = f"{row[cols[0]]}__{row[cols[1]]}"
   314→                return pair_dir_map.get(rev)
   315→            dir_ij = _lookup("ij")
   316→            dir_jk = _lookup("jk")
   317→            dir_ik = _lookup("ik")
   318→            if None in (dir_ij, dir_jk, dir_ik):
   319→                continue
   320→            try:
   321→                import rasterio
   322→                with rasterio.open(dir_ij / "ifg_goldstein.tif") as src:
   323→                    H, W = src.height, src.width
   324→            except Exception:
   325→                continue
   326→            T, S = tile_size, stride
   327→            for r in range(0, H - T + 1, S):
   328→                for c in range(0, W - T + 1, S):
   329→                    self.tiles.append((dir_ij, dir_jk, dir_ik, r, c))
   330→            # Cover bottom-right corner
   331→            if H > T:
   332→                for c in range(0, W - T + 1, S):
   333→                    self.tiles.append((dir_ij, dir_jk, dir_ik, H - T, c))
   334→            if W > T:
   335→                for r in range(0, H - T + 1, S):
   336→                    self.tiles.append((dir_ij, dir_jk, dir_ik, r, W - T))

   428→def temporal_split(pair_dirs: List[Path], train_frac: float, val_frac: float):
   429→    """Split pair dirs by date order (encoded in dir name YYYYMMDD_YYYYMMDD)."""
   430→    def _date_key(p: Path) -> str:

   433→    sorted_dirs = sorted(pair_dirs, key=_date_key)
   434→    n = len(sorted_dirs)
   435→    n_train = int(n * train_frac)

   437→    return (

   439→        sorted_dirs[n_train:n_train + n_val],

   470→def run_epoch(
   471→    model: FiLMUNet,
   472→    loader: DataLoader,
   473→    criterion: InSARLoss,
   474→    optimizer: Optional[torch.optim.Optimizer],
   475→    device: torch.device,
   476→    grad_clip: float = 1.0,
   477→    zero_metadata: bool = False,
   478→    triplet_loader: Optional[DataLoader] = None,
   479→) -> dict:
   480→    training = optimizer is not None
   481→    model.train(training)
   482→    totals: Dict[str, float] = {}
   483→    n = 0
   484→
   485→    # Prepare triplet iterator (cycles over triplet batches in lock-step with main loader)
   486→    _triplet_iter = iter(triplet_loader) if (triplet_loader is not None and training) else None
   487→
   488→    with torch.set_grad_enabled(training):
   489→        for batch in loader:
   490→            x    = batch["x"].float().to(device)          # (B, C, H, W) — raw (noisy)
   491→            gold = batch["gold"].float().to(device)        # (B, 2, H, W) — Goldstein (pseudo-clean)
   492→            meta = batch["metadata"].float().to(device)
   493→            if zero_metadata:
   494→                meta = torch.zeros_like(meta)              # ablation V5: no FiLM conditioning
   495→
   496→            denoised, log_var = model(x, meta)
   497→
   498→            inp = PhysicsLossInputs(
   499→                pred_a=denoised,      # model prediction on raw input
   500→                sublook_b=gold,       # Goldstein as N2N target
   501→                log_var=log_var,
   502→                full_look=gold,       # gradient loss: model output vs Goldstein
   503→            )
   504→            loss, breakdown = criterion(inp)
   505→

    16→def load_raster(path: str) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, rasterio.Affine, dict]:

    72→def resample_raster(

    54→def find_slc(raw_dir: Path, collect_id: str) -> Path | None:
    55→    """Return the .tif path for a collect ID, or None if not found."""
    56→    d = raw_dir / collect_id
    57→    if not d.exists():
    58→        return None
    59→    tifs = list(d.glob("*.tif"))
    60→    return tifs[0] if tifs else None

    63→def read_slc_patch(
    64→    tif_path: Path,
    65→    row_off: int,
    66→    col_off: int,
    67→    rows: int,
    68→    cols: int,
    69→) -> np.ndarray:
    70→    """
    71→    Read a complex patch from a Capella SLC GeoTIFF.
    72→
    73→    Returns complex64 array shape (rows, cols), or raises on error.
    74→    rasterio reads CInt16 as complex64 automatically.
    75→    """
    76→    with rasterio.open(tif_path) as src:
    77→        row_off = max(0, min(row_off, src.height - rows))
    78→        col_off = max(0, min(col_off, src.width - cols))
    79→        window = Window(col_off, row_off, cols, rows)
    80→        data = src.read(1, window=window)
    81→    return data.astype(np.complex64)

    85→    """Return (height, width) of an SLC without reading data."""
    86→    with rasterio.open(tif_path) as src:
    87→        return src.height, src.width

    94→def estimate_offset_cc(
    95→    ref: np.ndarray,
    96→    sec: np.ndarray,
    97→    upsample_factor: int = 10,
    98→) -> tuple[float, float, float]:
    99→    """
   100→    Estimate (row_offset, col_offset) to align `sec` to `ref` via
   101→    phase cross-correlation in the frequency domain.
   102→
   103→    Uses a sub-set of the image (centre region) for speed.
   104→
   105→    Parameters
   106→    ----------
   107→    ref, sec : np.ndarray   complex or real 2-D arrays (same shape)
   108→    upsample_factor : int   sub-pixel precision: 1/upsample_factor pixels
   109→
   110→    Returns
   111→    -------
   112→    (row_offset, col_offset, cc_peak_score) : floats
   113→        shift to apply to sec to align to ref; cc_peak_score ∈ [0,1]
   114→    """
   115→    # Use intensity images for cross-correlation (more stable than phase)
   116→    ref_int = np.abs(ref).astype(np.float32)
   117→    sec_int = np.abs(sec).astype(np.float32)
   118→
   119→    # Subtract mean to suppress DC component
   120→    ref_int -= ref_int.mean()
   121→    sec_int -= sec_int.mean()
   122→
   123→    # Cross-correlation via FFT
   124→    R = np.fft.fft2(ref_int) * np.conj(np.fft.fft2(sec_int))
   125→    R /= (np.abs(R) + 1e-10)           # normalised cross-correlation (phase only)
   126→    cc = np.fft.ifft2(R).real
   127→
   128→    # Find peak
   129→    rows, cols = cc.shape
   130→    peak_flat = np.argmax(cc)
   131→    r_peak, c_peak = np.unravel_index(peak_flat, (rows, cols))
   132→
   133→    # CC quality score: peak / max → always [0, 1]
   134→    cc_max = float(cc.max())
   135→    cc_peak_score = float(cc[r_peak, c_peak] / cc_max) if cc_max > 0 else 0.0
   136→
   137→    # Wrap offsets to (-N/2, N/2)
   138→    r_off = r_peak if r_peak < rows // 2 else r_peak - rows
   139→    c_off = c_peak if c_peak < cols // 2 else c_peak - cols
   140→
   141→    if upsample_factor <= 1:
   142→        return float(r_off), float(c_off), cc_peak_score
   143→
   144→    # Sub-pixel refinement via DFT upsampling in a small neighbourhood
   145→    r_off_sub, c_off_sub = _subpixel_offset(R, r_off, c_off, upsample_factor)
   146→    return r_off_sub, c_off_sub, cc_peak_score
   147→
   148→
   149→def _subpixel_offset(
   150→    R_norm: np.ndarray,
   151→    r_int: int,
   152→    c_int: int,
   153→    upsample: int,
   154→) -> tuple[float, float]:
   155→    """
   156→    Sub-pixel offset refinement via partial DFT upsampling (Guizar-Sicairos 2008).
   157→    Evaluates the cross-correlation in a (1.5 × 1.5)-pixel region around (r_int, c_int)
   158→    at upsample × resolution.
   159→    """
   160→    rows, cols = R_norm.shape
   161→    region = upsample * 1.5
   162→
   163→    # Frequency indices
   164→    freq_r = np.fft.ifftshift(np.arange(-np.fix(rows / 2), np.ceil(rows / 2))) / rows
   165→    freq_c = np.fft.ifftshift(np.arange(-np.fix(cols / 2), np.ceil(cols / 2))) / cols
   166→
   167→    up_rows = int(np.ceil(region * upsample))
   168→    up_cols = int(np.ceil(region * upsample))
   169→
   170→    row_shift = np.arange(-np.fix(up_rows / 2), np.ceil(up_rows / 2)) / upsample + r_int
   171→    col_shift = np.arange(-np.fix(up_cols / 2), np.ceil(up_cols / 2)) / upsample + c_int
   172→
   173→    # Partial DFT: CC(row_shift, col_shift) = sum_k sum_l R(k,l) exp(2πi(k*dr + l*dc))
   174→    kern_r = np.exp(2j * np.pi * np.outer(row_shift, freq_r))
   175→    kern_c = np.exp(2j * np.pi * np.outer(freq_c, col_shift))
   176→    cc_up = (kern_r @ R_norm @ kern_c).real
   177→
   178→    peak_flat = np.argmax(cc_up)
   179→    rp, cp = np.unravel_index(peak_flat, cc_up.shape)
   180→    return float(row_shift[rp]), float(col_shift[cp])
   181→
   182→
   183→def apply_shift(
   184→    slc: np.ndarray,
   185→    row_off: float,
   186→    col_off: float,
   187→) -> np.ndarray:
   188→    """
   189→    Shift a complex SLC by (row_off, col_off) pixels via FFT phase ramp.
   190→
   191→    Fractional shifts are handled by applying a linear phase ramp in the
   192→    frequency domain — exact for band-limited signals.
   193→    """
   194→    rows, cols = slc.shape
   195→    fr = np.fft.fftfreq(rows)[:, np.newaxis]
   196→    fc = np.fft.fftfreq(cols)[np.newaxis, :]
   197→    phase_ramp = np.exp(-2j * np.pi * (row_off * fr + col_off * fc))
   198→    shifted = np.fft.ifft2(np.fft.fft2(slc) * phase_ramp)
   199→    return shifted.astype(slc.dtype)

   202→def estimate_offset_grid(
   203→    ref: np.ndarray,
   204→    sec: np.ndarray,
   205→    n_grid: int = 3,
   206→    patch_frac: float = 0.15,
   207→    upsample_factor: int = 10,
   208→    min_cc_score: float = 0.05,
   209→) -> dict:
   210→    """
   211→    Estimate coregistration offset from a n_grid × n_grid regular patch grid.
   212→
   213→    Patches are placed at evenly-spaced positions across the image (avoiding
   214→    the first and last 20% of each axis).  Each patch contributes an
   215→    independent (row_off, col_off, cc_score) estimate.  The returned offset
   216→    is the CC-score-weighted mean over accepted patches.
   217→
   218→    Parameters
   219→    ----------
   220→    ref, sec        : 2-D complex arrays (same shape)
   221→    n_grid          : grid dimension (default 3 → 9 patches)
   222→    patch_frac      : patch side = max(H,W) * patch_frac (default 0.15 → ~614 px for 4096)
   223→    min_cc_score    : patches below this CC score are excluded from the mean
   224→
   225→    Returns
   226→    -------
   227→    dict with keys:
   228→        row_offset_px           float  weighted-mean row shift
   229→        col_offset_px           float  weighted-mean col shift
   230→        cc_peak_mean            float  mean CC score of accepted patches
   231→        cc_peak_min             float  min  CC score of accepted patches
   232→        n_patches_ok            int    number of patches above min_cc_score
   233→        offset_row_std          float  std of row offsets across patches (px)
   234→        offset_col_std          float  std of col offsets across patches (px)
   235→        estimated_rotation_mrad float  rotation from affine fit (informational only)
   236→    """
   237→    H, W = ref.shape
   238→    patch_size = max(64, int(max(H, W) * patch_frac))
   239→
   240→    # Grid centres at evenly-spaced positions, avoiding the outer 20% of each axis
   241→    row_frac = np.linspace(0.2, 0.8, n_grid)
   242→    col_frac = np.linspace(0.2, 0.8, n_grid)
   243→
   244→    offsets_r, offsets_c, scores = [], [], []
   245→    cx_list, cy_list = [], []  # patch centre positions (for affine rotation fit)
   246→
   247→    for rf in row_frac:
   248→        for cf in col_frac:
   249→            r0 = int(rf * H) - patch_size // 2
   250→            c0 = int(cf * W) - patch_size // 2
   251→            r0 = max(0, min(r0, H - patch_size))
   252→            c0 = max(0, min(c0, W - patch_size))
   253→            r1, c1 = r0 + patch_size, c0 + patch_size
   254→
   255→            patch_r = ref[r0:r1, c0:c1]
   256→            patch_s = sec[r0:r1, c0:c1]
   257→
   258→            try:
   259→                dr, dc, score = estimate_offset_cc(patch_r, patch_s, upsample_factor)
   260→            except Exception:
   261→                continue
   262→
   263→            offsets_r.append(dr)
   264→            offsets_c.append(dc)
   265→            scores.append(score)
   266→            cx_list.append(cf * W)
   267→            cy_list.append(rf * H)
   268→
   269→    if not offsets_r:
   270→        # Fallback to centre patch
   271→        dr, dc, score = estimate_offset_cc(ref, sec, upsample_factor)
   272→        return {
   273→            "row_offset_px": dr, "col_offset_px": dc,
   274→            "cc_peak_mean": score, "cc_peak_min": score,
   275→            "n_patches_ok": 1, "offset_row_std": 0.0, "offset_col_std": 0.0,
   276→            "estimated_rotation_mrad": 0.0,
   277→        }
   278→
   279→    offsets_r = np.array(offsets_r)
   280→    offsets_c = np.array(offsets_c)
   281→    scores    = np.array(scores)
   282→
   283→    # Filter by min CC score
   284→    ok = scores >= min_cc_score
   285→    if ok.sum() == 0:
   286→        ok = np.ones(len(scores), dtype=bool)  # accept all if none pass threshold
   287→
   288→    offsets_r_ok = offsets_r[ok]
   289→    offsets_c_ok = offsets_c[ok]
   290→    scores_ok    = scores[ok]
   291→    cx_ok        = np.array(cx_list)[ok]
   292→    cy_ok        = np.array(cy_list)[ok]
   293→
   294→    # CC-score-weighted mean offset
   295→    w = scores_ok / scores_ok.sum()
   296→    mean_dr = float((w * offsets_r_ok).sum())
   297→    mean_dc = float((w * offsets_c_ok).sum())
   298→
   299→    # Consistency: std of offsets (near 0 for pure translation / flat terrain)
   300→    std_r = float(offsets_r_ok.std()) if len(offsets_r_ok) > 1 else 0.0
   301→    std_c = float(offsets_c_ok.std()) if len(offsets_c_ok) > 1 else 0.0
   302→
   303→    # Affine rotation estimate (informational only — NOT applied):
   304→    # Fit dr = a0 + a1*cx + a2*cy; dc = b0 + b1*cx + b2*cy
   305→    # rotation ≈ (a2 - b1) / 2 [rad/px] → mrad/1000px
   306→    rotation_mrad = 0.0
   307→    if len(offsets_r_ok) >= 3:
   308→        try:
   309→            A_fit = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(cx_ok)), cx_ok, cy_ok])
   310→            coef_r, _, _, _ = np.linalg.lstsq(A_fit, offsets_r_ok, rcond=None)
   311→            coef_c, _, _, _ = np.linalg.lstsq(A_fit, offsets_c_ok, rcond=None)
   312→            rotation_mrad = float((coef_r[2] - coef_c[1]) / 2 * 1000)
   313→        except Exception:
   314→            pass
   315→
   316→    return {
   317→        "row_offset_px":            mean_dr,
   318→        "col_offset_px":            mean_dc,
   319→        "cc_peak_mean":             float(scores_ok.mean()),
   320→        "cc_peak_min":              float(scores_ok.min()),
   321→        "n_patches_ok":             int(ok.sum()),
   322→        "offset_row_std":           std_r,
   323→        "offset_col_std":           std_c,
   324→        "estimated_rotation_mrad":  rotation_mrad,
   325→    }
   326→

   328→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   329→# Interferogram + coherence
   330→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   331→
   332→def form_interferogram(
   333→    slc_ref: np.ndarray,
   334→    slc_sec: np.ndarray,
   335→    normalize: bool = True,
   336→) -> np.ndarray:
   337→    """
   338→    Form complex interferogram: ifg = slc_ref × conj(slc_sec).
   339→
   340→    If normalize=True, each pixel is normalised to unit amplitude, isolating
   341→    the interferometric phase (useful for training data).
   342→    """
   343→    ifg = slc_ref * np.conj(slc_sec)
   344→    if normalize:
   345→        amp = np.abs(ifg)
   346→        ifg = ifg / (amp + 1e-10)
   347→    return ifg.astype(np.complex64)
   348→

   354→def save_complex_tif(arr: np.ndarray, path: Path, crs=None, transform=None) -> None:
   355→    """Save a complex float32 array as a 2-band GeoTIFF (Re, Im)."""
   356→    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   357→    profile = {
   358→        "driver": "GTiff",
   359→        "dtype": "float32",
   360→        "count": 2,
   361→        "height": arr.shape[0],
   362→        "width": arr.shape[1],
   363→        "compress": "deflate",
   364→        "tiled": True,
   365→        "blockxsize": 256,
   366→        "blockysize": 256,
   367→    }
   368→    if crs:
   369→        profile["crs"] = crs
   370→    if transform:
   371→        profile["transform"] = transform
   372→
   373→    with rasterio.open(path, "w", **profile) as dst:
   374→        dst.write(arr.real.astype(np.float32), 1)
   375→        dst.write(arr.imag.astype(np.float32), 2)
   376→
   377→
   378→def save_float_tif(arr: np.ndarray, path: Path, crs=None, transform=None) -> None:
   379→    """Save a real float32 array as a single-band GeoTIFF."""
   380→    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   381→    profile = {
   382→        "driver": "GTiff",
   383→        "dtype": "float32",
   384→        "count": 1,
   385→        "height": arr.shape[0],
   386→        "width": arr.shape[1],
   387→        "compress": "deflate",
   388→        "tiled": True,
   389→        "blockxsize": 256,
   390→        "blockysize": 256,
   391→    }
   392→    if crs:
   393→        profile["crs"] = crs
   394→    if transform:
   395→        profile["transform"] = transform
   396→
   397→    with rasterio.open(path, "w", **profile) as dst:
   398→        dst.write(arr.astype(np.float32), 1)

   401→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   402→# Single-pair processing

   404→
   405→def process_pair(
   406→    row: pd.Series,
   407→    raw_dir: Path,
   408→    out_dir: Path,
   409→    patch_size: int,
   410→    looks_range: int,
   411→    looks_azimuth: int,
   412→    goldstein_alpha: float,
   413→    use_adaptive: bool,
   414→    coreg_n_grid: int = 3,
   415→) -> dict:
   416→    """
   417→    Process one interferometric pair end-to-end.
   418→
   419→    Steps
   420→    -----
   421→    1. Find SLC .tif files
   422→    2. Determine overlapping patch region (centre of both images)
   423→    3. Read patches
   424→    4. Estimate coregistration offset
   425→    5. Shift secondary SLC
   426→    6. Form interferogram
   427→    7. Estimate coherence
   428→    8. Apply Goldstein filter
   429→    9. Save: raw ifg, coherence, filtered ifg
   430→
   431→    Returns
   432→    -------
   433→    dict with "ok": bool and optional "error": str
   434→    """
   435→    id_ref, id_sec = row["id_ref"], row["id_sec"]
   436→
   437→    # --- Locate SLC files ---
   438→    tif_ref = find_slc(raw_dir, id_ref)
   439→    tif_sec = find_slc(raw_dir, id_sec)
   440→    if tif_ref is None or tif_sec is None:
   441→        return {"ok": False, "error": f"Missing SLC: ref={tif_ref} sec={tif_sec}"}
   442→
   443→    # --- Determine centre patch (use smaller of the two images) ---
   444→    h_ref, w_ref = get_slc_shape(tif_ref)
   445→    h_sec, w_sec = get_slc_shape(tif_sec)
   446→    ps = patch_size
   447→    row_r = max(0, h_ref // 2 - ps // 2)
   448→    col_r = max(0, w_ref // 2 - ps // 2)
   449→    row_s = max(0, h_sec // 2 - ps // 2)
   450→    col_s = max(0, w_sec // 2 - ps // 2)
   451→
   452→    try:
   453→        slc_ref = read_slc_patch(tif_ref, row_r, col_r, ps, ps)
   454→        slc_sec = read_slc_patch(tif_sec, row_s, col_s, ps, ps)
   455→    except Exception as e:
   456→        return {"ok": False, "error": f"Read error: {e}"}
   457→
   458→    # --- Coregistration ---
   459→    coreg_stats: dict = {}
   460→    dr, dc = 0.0, 0.0
   461→    try:
   462→        result = estimate_offset_grid(slc_ref, slc_sec, n_grid=coreg_n_grid, upsample_factor=10)
   463→        dr = result["row_offset_px"]
   464→        dc = result["col_offset_px"]
   465→        coreg_stats = result
   466→        log.debug(
   467→            "  Coreg offset: dr=%.3f dc=%.3f px | cc_mean=%.3f cc_min=%.3f n=%d "
   468→            "std_r=%.3f std_c=%.3f rot=%.2f mrad",
   469→            dr, dc,
   470→            result["cc_peak_mean"], result["cc_peak_min"], result["n_patches_ok"],
   471→            result["offset_row_std"], result["offset_col_std"],
   472→            result["estimated_rotation_mrad"],
   473→        )
   474→        slc_sec_coreg = apply_shift(slc_sec, dr, dc)
   475→    except Exception as e:
   476→        log.warning("Coregistration failed for %s/%s: %s", id_ref[:30], id_sec[:30], e)
   477→        slc_sec_coreg = slc_sec
   478→
   479→    # --- Interferogram ---
   480→    ifg = form_interferogram(slc_ref, slc_sec_coreg, normalize=False)
   481→
   482→    # --- Coherence ---
   483→    ifg_raw = form_interferogram(slc_ref, slc_sec_coreg, normalize=False)
   484→    coherence = boxcar_coherence(
   485→        ifg_raw, slc_ref, slc_sec_coreg,
   486→        looks_range=looks_range, looks_azimuth=looks_azimuth,
   487→    )
   488→
   489→    # --- Goldstein filter ---
   490→    try:
   491→        if use_adaptive:
   492→            ifg_filtered = adaptive_goldstein(
   493→                ifg_raw, coherence,
   494→                block_size=32, overlap=8,
   495→            )
   496→        else:
   497→            from src.insar_processing.filters import goldstein
   498→            ifg_filtered = goldstein(ifg_raw, alpha=goldstein_alpha, block_size=32, overlap=8)
   499→    except Exception as e:
   500→        log.warning("Goldstein filter failed: %s", e)
   501→        ifg_filtered = ifg_raw
   502→
   503→    # --- Save ---
   504→    pair_id = f"{id_ref}__{id_sec}"
   505→    pair_dir = out_dir / pair_id  # full ID (104 chars max, well under 255 limit)
   506→    pair_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   507→
   508→    save_complex_tif(ifg_raw.astype(np.complex64), pair_dir / "ifg_raw.tif")
   509→    save_float_tif(coherence, pair_dir / "coherence.tif")
   510→    save_complex_tif(ifg_filtered.astype(np.complex64), pair_dir / "ifg_goldstein.tif")
   511→
   512→    # Save coregistration metadata
   513→    import json
   514→    with open(pair_dir / "coreg_meta.json", "w") as f:
   515→        json.dump({
   516→            "id_ref":              id_ref,
   517→            "id_sec":              id_sec,
   518→            "dt_days":             float(row.get("dt_days", 0)),
   519→            "dinc_deg":            float(row.get("dinc_deg", 0)),
   520→            "q_score":             float(row.get("q_score", 0)),
   521→            "bperp_m":             float(row.get("bperp_m", 0)) if "bperp_m" in row.index else None,
   522→            "row_offset_px":       dr,
   523→            "col_offset_px":       dc,
   524→            "patch_size":          ps,
   525→            "patch_row_ref":       row_r,
   526→            "patch_col_ref":       col_r,
   527→            # Coregistration quality metrics (multi-patch grid)
   528→            "cc_peak_mean":        coreg_stats.get("cc_peak_mean",  None),
   529→            "cc_peak_min":         coreg_stats.get("cc_peak_min",   None),
   530→            "n_coreg_patches":     coreg_stats.get("n_patches_ok",  None),
   531→            "offset_row_std_px":   coreg_stats.get("offset_row_std", None),
   532→            "offset_col_std_px":   coreg_stats.get("offset_col_std", None),
   533→        }, f, indent=2)
   534→

     3→
     4→Five components, all operating on wrapped complex interferograms:
     5→
     6→1. L_n2n      — Noise2Noise L1 between two independent sub-look views
     7→2. L_unc      — Heteroscedastic NLL (encourages calibrated uncertainty)
     8→3. L_closure  — Triplet closure-consistency weighted by coherence/uncertainty
     9→4. L_temporal — SBAS-like stack inversion residual
    10→5. L_grad     — Fringe-preservation gradient loss
    11→
    12→Combined:
    13→    L = λ_n2n * L_n2n
    14→      + λ_unc * L_unc
    15→      + λ_closure * L_closure
    16→      + λ_temporal * L_temporal
    17→      + λ_grad * L_grad
    18→
    19→Phase tensors throughout are 2-channel (Re, Im).
    20→The wrapped phase of a 2ch tensor x is atan2(x[:,1], x[:,0]).
    21→"""

    23→from dataclasses import dataclass, field
    24→from typing import List, Optional

    27→import torch.nn.functional as F

    30→# ─── helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    32→def _phase(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    33→    """Wrapped phase from 2ch Re/Im tensor. Returns (B, H, W)."""
    34→    return torch.atan2(x[:, 1], x[:, 0])
    35→
    36→
    37→def _wrap(phi: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    38→    """Wrap phase to [-π, π]."""
    39→    return torch.atan2(torch.sin(phi), torch.cos(phi))

    41→
    42→def _complex_mul_conj(a: torch.Tensor, b: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    43→    """Multiply a by conjugate(b), both 2ch Re/Im.  Returns 2ch Re/Im."""

    48→
    49→# ─── individual losses ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    50→
    51→def noise2noise_loss(
    52→    pred_a: torch.Tensor,

    54→) -> torch.Tensor:

    83→    Args:

    96→
    97→def closure_loss(
    98→    phi_ij: torch.Tensor,

   124→
   125→def temporal_consistency_loss(
   126→    phi_hat: torch.Tensor,

   131→    SBAS-like stack inversion residual.

   140→        phi_hat:      (P, N) — stack of P unwrapped-like phase maps, N pixels

   148→        coh_weights = torch.ones_like(phi_hat)

   151→    # A: (P, T), W: diagonal from coh_weights mean over pixels (P,)
   152→    W_diag = coh_weights.mean(dim=1)               # (P,) — one weight per pair
   153→    W_sqrt = W_diag.sqrt().unsqueeze(1)            # (P, 1)
   154→    Aw = A * W_sqrt                                # (P, T) — weighted design matrix
   155→    phi_w = phi_hat * W_sqrt                       # (P, N)
   156→
   157→    # Solve: x_star = lstsq(Aw, phi_w)
   158→    x_star = torch.linalg.lstsq(Aw, phi_w).solution  # (T, N)

   188→    dx_pred = phi_pred[:, :, :, 1:] - phi_pred[:, :, :, :-1]

   190→    dx_tgt = phi_tgt[:, :, :, 1:] - phi_tgt[:, :, :, :-1]

   196→# ─── combined loss ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

   198→@dataclass

   218→    phi_jk: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None   # (B, H, W)
   219→    phi_ik: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None   # (B, H, W)

```python
def save_complex_tif(arr: np.ndarray, path: Path, crs=None, transform=None) -> None:
    """Save a complex float32 array as a 2-band GeoTIFF (Re, Im)."""
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    profile = {
        "driver": "GTiff",
        "dtype": "float32",
        "count": 2,
        "height": arr.shape[0],
        "width": arr.shape[1],
        "compress": "deflate",
        "tiled": True,
        "blockxsize": 256,
        "blockysize": 256,
    }
    if crs:
        profile["crs"] = crs
    if transform:
        profile["transform"] = transform

    with rasterio.open(path, "w", **profile) as dst:
        dst.write(arr.real.astype(np.float32), 1)
        dst.write(arr.imag.astype(np.float32), 2)
```

# What To Do Now — Mar 21 Action Plan
**Date**: 2026-03-21 | **Deadline**: April 06, 2026 (16 days)

---

## Current State

The coregistration improvements are **done**. The current blocker is that the model
(raw2gold_30ep) shows **no improvement** over the Goldstein baseline:

| Metric | Goldstein | FiLMUNet | Status |
|--------|-----------|----------|--------|
| M1 Triplet Closure | 1.018 rad | 1.021 rad | WORSE (closure loss was off) |
| M2 Unwrap Success | 0.256 | — | FiLMUNet not unwrapped yet |
| M3 Usable Pairs | 0.000 | 0.000 | M1 > 0.5 gate |
| M5 Temporal Residual | 0.050 rad | 2.977 rad | **INVALID** (weight-scale bug) |

Two bugs are blocking real progress. Fix them both, then retrain.

---

## Bug 1 — M5 Weight-Scale Bug (30 min fix)

**File**: `src/evaluation/closure_metrics.py`, line 207

**Root cause**: `temporal_consistency_residual()` returns `‖W(phi − Ax*)‖₂` — a
*weighted* residual. For Goldstein, W = I (uniform), so the metric is in radians.
For FiLMUNet, W = diag(1/σ²) where σ² = exp(log_var). If the model outputs
log_var ≈ −5, then weights ≈ 149 and the residual is scaled by 149 — a ~3000%
inflation that is NOT a real increase in phase inconsistency.

**Fix in `src/evaluation/closure_metrics.py`** — lines 205–207:

```python
# CURRENT (wrong — residual is in weighted space, not phase radians):
x_star, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(Aw, phw, rcond=None)
residual = phw - Aw @ x_star
return float(np.sqrt(np.mean(residual ** 2)))

# FIX — use weights only for inversion; report unweighted phase-space residual:
x_star, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(Aw, phw, rcond=None)
raw_residual = phi_stack - A @ x_star   # unweighted, in radians
return float(np.sqrt(np.mean(raw_residual ** 2)))
```

This lets the FiLMUNet uncertainty weights improve the SBAS inversion (get better
x_star), but the reported metric stays in radians and is comparable between methods.

**Also normalize weights in `eval/compute_metrics.py`** line 577 (belt-and-suspenders):

```python
weights = np.array(weights_list, dtype=np.float32)
weights = weights / weights.mean()   # prevent scale inflation
```

---

## Bug 2 — Closure Loss Never Active (fix + retrain ~10h)

**File**: `experiments/enhanced/train_film_unet.py` / training command

**Root cause**: `--triplets_manifest` was never passed to training. The code correctly
gates the entire closure loss branch on `triplet_loader is not None`, so with no
manifest → no triplet loader → `val_closure = 0.0000` every epoch. The training command
in logs and MEMORY.md does NOT include `--triplets_manifest`.

**Fix**: simply pass the flag when re-launching training.

```bash
  env PYTHONPATH=/scratch/gdemil24/Learning-Assisted-InSAR-DEM-Enhancement \
      LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/scratch/gdemil24/hrwsi_s3client/torch-gpu/lib \
  python experiments/enhanced/train_film_unet.py \
    --data_config  configs/data/capella_aoi_selection.yaml \
    --model_config configs/model/film_unet.yaml \
    --train_config configs/train/contest.yaml \
    --run_name     raw2gold_closure \
```

# Plan: Fix training log + suppress georeference warning

## Context

Two issues reported during `raw2gold_closure` training (epoch 15/50):
1. `val_closure=0.0000` every epoch — user suspects closure loss is disabled

```python
# Note: no triplet_loader argument passed
```

Inside `run_epoch()`:
```python
_triplet_iter = iter(triplet_loader) if (triplet_loader is not None and training) else None
```

Two guards prevent triplets in validation:
- `triplet_loader` is never passed to the val call
- `and training` is False when `optimizer=None`

**Closure is only computed in the TRAINING pass. `val_closure` will always be 0 — this is correct.**

### How to verify closure IS active in training
Check training startup log for:
```
TripletTileDataset: N triplet-tiles from M triplets
```

If N > 0, triplets are loaded and closure loss runs in training.

**File**: `experiments/enhanced/train_film_unet.py`

```python
         epoch, num_epochs,
         train_metrics["loss"], val_metrics["loss"],
         train_metrics.get("closure", 0.0),
         val_metrics.get("closure", 0.0), scheduler.get_last_lr()[0])
```

## Issue 2 — NotGeoreferencedWarning (suppress in DataLoader)

`save_complex_tif()` and `save_float_tif()` in `src/insar_processing/io.py` write GeoTIFFs
without CRS or geotransform (called from `preprocess_pairs.py` without passing `crs`/`transform`).

```
NotGeoreferencedWarning: Dataset has no geotransform, gcps, or rpcs.
```

This fires for every tile in every batch — harmless but extremely noisy.

### Fix A — suppress in DataLoader worker processes

**File**: `experiments/enhanced/train_film_unet.py`

Add a worker init function:
```python
import warnings

def _worker_init(worker_id: int) -> None:
    try:
        import rasterio.errors
        warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=rasterio.errors.NotGeoreferencedWarning)
    except Exception:
        pass
```

Pass to all DataLoader constructors:
```python
DataLoader(..., worker_init_fn=_worker_init)
```

### Fix B — suppress in main process too

Add before DataLoader creation:
```python
try:
    import rasterio.errors
    warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=rasterio.errors.NotGeoreferencedWarning)
except ImportError:
    pass
```

---

## Critical Files

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `experiments/enhanced/train_film_unet.py` | (1) Add `train_closure` to epoch log line; (2) Add `_worker_init` fn; (3) Suppress warning in main process |

---

After applying fixes, epoch log should show:
```
Epoch  16/50 | train_loss=-0.5124 val_loss=0.1728 train_closure=0.0312 val_closure=0.0000 lr=8.31e-05
```

- `val_closure = 0.0000` is expected and correct ✓

class InSARTileDataset(Dataset):
    """
    Loads preprocessed interferogram tiles for FiLMUNet training.

    Each item in the manifest points to a directory containing:
        ifg_goldstein.tif   — complex interferogram (CInt16 / float32 Re+Im)
        coherence.tif       — coherence [0,1]
        coreg_meta.json     — pair metadata (dates, B_perp, inc_angle, …)

    Returns a dict with:
        x        (3, H, W) float32 — Re, Im, coherence
        metadata (7,)      float32 — FiLM conditioning vector
        phi      (H, W)    float32 — wrapped phase (for closure loss)
        pair_id  str
    """

    # Metadata normalisation constants (approximate physical ranges)
    _META_MEAN = np.array([30.0, 45.0, 35.0, 500.0, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5], dtype=np.float32)
    _META_STD  = np.array([60.0,  8.0,  8.0, 2000.0, 0.5, 0.5, 0.3], dtype=np.float32)

    def __init__(
        self,
        pair_dirs: List[Path],
        tile_size: int = 256,
        stride: int = 128,
        min_coherence: float = 0.15,
        augment: bool = False,
        in_channels: int = 3,
    ):
        self.tile_size = tile_size
        self.stride = stride
        self.min_coherence = min_coherence
        self.augment = augment
        self.in_channels = in_channels

        self.tiles: List[Tuple[Path, int, int]] = []  # (pair_dir, row_off, col_off)
        for pd_path in pair_dirs:
            self._index_pair(pd_path)

    def _index_pair(self, pair_dir: Path) -> None:
        ifg_path = pair_dir / "ifg_goldstein.tif"
        coh_path = pair_dir / "coherence.tif"
        if not ifg_path.exists() or not coh_path.exists():
            return
        try:
            import rasterio
            with rasterio.open(coh_path) as src:
                H, W = src.height, src.width
        except Exception:
            return
        T = self.tile_size
        S = self.stride
        for r in range(0, H - T + 1, S):
            for c in range(0, W - T + 1, S):
                self.tiles.append((pair_dir, r, c))

    def _load_tile(self, pair_dir: Path, r: int, c: int):
        import rasterio
        T = self.tile_size
        window = rasterio.windows.Window(c, r, T, T)

        # Goldstein (pseudo-clean target)
        with rasterio.open(pair_dir / "ifg_goldstein.tif") as src:
            data = src.read(window=window)
            if data.shape[0] == 1:
                cplx = data[0].astype(np.complex64)
                re_gold, im_gold = cplx.real, cplx.imag
            else:
                re_gold, im_gold = data[0].astype(np.float32), data[1].astype(np.float32)

        # Raw (noisy input) — fallback to Goldstein if missing
        raw_path = pair_dir / "ifg_raw.tif"
        if raw_path.exists():
            with rasterio.open(raw_path) as src:
                data = src.read(window=window)
                if data.shape[0] == 1:
                    cplx = data[0].astype(np.complex64)
                    re_raw, im_raw = cplx.real, cplx.imag
                else:
                    re_raw, im_raw = data[0].astype(np.float32), data[1].astype(np.float32)
        else:
            re_raw, im_raw = re_gold, im_gold

        with rasterio.open(pair_dir / "coherence.tif") as src:
            coh = src.read(1, window=window).astype(np.float32)

        # Guard against NaN/Inf from edge pixels or masked nodata
        re_raw  = np.nan_to_num(re_raw,  nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
        im_raw  = np.nan_to_num(im_raw,  nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
        re_gold = np.nan_to_num(re_gold, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
        im_gold = np.nan_to_num(im_gold, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
        coh     = np.nan_to_num(coh,     nan=0.0, posinf=1.0, neginf=0.0)

        return re_raw, im_raw, re_gold, im_gold, coh

    def _load_meta(self, pair_dir: Path) -> np.ndarray:
        meta_path = pair_dir / "coreg_meta.json"
        try:
            with open(meta_path) as f:
                m = json.load(f)
            dt = float(m.get("dt_days", 30.0))          # key from preprocess_pairs.py
            inc = float(m.get("incidence_angle_deg", 45.0))  # not in coreg_meta; use default
            graze = 90.0 - inc
            bperp = float(m.get("bperp_m", 500.0))      # key from preprocess_pairs.py
            mode = 1.0 if str(m.get("mode", "")).upper() == "SL" else 0.0
            look = 1.0 if str(m.get("look_direction", "")).upper() == "RIGHT" else 0.0
            snr = float(m.get("snr_proxy", 0.5))
            raw = np.array([dt, inc, graze, bperp, mode, look, snr], dtype=np.float32)
        except Exception:
            raw = self._META_MEAN.copy()
        return (raw - self._META_MEAN) / (self._META_STD + 1e-8)

    @staticmethod
    def _load_meta_static(pair_dir: Path) -> np.ndarray:
        """Static version of _load_meta — used by TripletTileDataset."""
        _META_MEAN = np.array([30.0, 45.0, 35.0, 500.0, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5], dtype=np.float32)
        _META_STD  = np.array([60.0,  8.0,  8.0, 2000.0, 0.5, 0.5, 0.3], dtype=np.float32)
        meta_path = pair_dir / "coreg_meta.json"
        try:
            with open(meta_path) as f:
                m = json.load(f)
            dt    = float(m.get("dt_days", 30.0))
            inc   = float(m.get("incidence_angle_deg", 45.0))
            graze = 90.0 - inc
            bperp = float(m.get("bperp_m", 500.0))
            mode  = 1.0 if str(m.get("mode", "")).upper() == "SL" else 0.0
            look  = 1.0 if str(m.get("look_direction", "")).upper() == "RIGHT" else 0.0
            snr   = float(m.get("snr_proxy", 0.5))
            raw   = np.array([dt, inc, graze, bperp, mode, look, snr], dtype=np.float32)
        except Exception:
            raw = _META_MEAN.copy()
        return (raw - _META_MEAN) / (_META_STD + 1e-8)

    @staticmethod
    def _augment(re_raw, im_raw, re_gold, im_gold, coh):
        """Physically-safe augmentations: rotations, flips, global phase offset."""
        k = random.randint(0, 3)
        re_raw  = np.rot90(re_raw,  k).copy()
        im_raw  = np.rot90(im_raw,  k).copy()
        re_gold = np.rot90(re_gold, k).copy()
        im_gold = np.rot90(im_gold, k).copy()
        coh     = np.rot90(coh,     k).copy()
        if random.random() > 0.5:
            re_raw  = np.fliplr(re_raw).copy()
            im_raw  = np.fliplr(im_raw).copy()
            re_gold = np.fliplr(re_gold).copy()
            im_gold = np.fliplr(im_gold).copy()
            coh     = np.fliplr(coh).copy()
        # Global phase offset applied consistently to both raw and gold
        phi_offset = random.uniform(-np.pi, np.pi)
        cos_o, sin_o = np.cos(phi_offset), np.sin(phi_offset)
        re_raw_new  = re_raw  * cos_o - im_raw  * sin_o
        im_raw_new  = re_raw  * sin_o + im_raw  * cos_o
        re_gold_new = re_gold * cos_o - im_gold * sin_o
        im_gold_new = re_gold * sin_o + im_gold * cos_o
        # Amplitude jitter ±10%
        scale = random.uniform(0.9, 1.1)
        return re_raw_new * scale, im_raw_new * scale, re_gold_new * scale, im_gold_new * scale, coh

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self.tiles)

    def __getitem__(self, idx: int) -> Optional[dict]:
        pair_dir, r, c = self.tiles[idx]
        re_raw, im_raw, re_gold, im_gold, coh = self._load_tile(pair_dir, r, c)

        if coh.mean() < self.min_coherence:
            # Return a random other tile to avoid None in DataLoader
            alt = random.randint(0, len(self.tiles) - 1)
            return self[alt]

        if self.augment:
            re_raw, im_raw, re_gold, im_gold, coh = self._augment(
                re_raw, im_raw, re_gold, im_gold, coh)

        meta = self._load_meta(pair_dir)
        phi = np.arctan2(im_gold, re_gold).astype(np.float32)  # Goldstein phase as reference

        if self.in_channels == 3:
            x = np.stack([re_raw, im_raw, coh], axis=0)    # noisy input
        else:
            x = np.stack([re_raw, im_raw], axis=0)

        gold = np.stack([re_gold, im_gold], axis=0)         # pseudo-clean target

        return {
            "x":        torch.from_numpy(x),
            "gold":     torch.from_numpy(gold),
            "metadata": torch.from_numpy(meta),
            "phi":      torch.from_numpy(phi),
            "pair_id":  str(pair_dir.name),
        }


def _pair_key(row, edge: str) -> str:
    """Build pair dir name (id_ref__id_sec) from triplet row for edge 'ij', 'jk', or 'ik'.

    Triplet manifest columns: id_a, id_b, id_c.
    Edge mapping: ij=a→b, jk=b→c, ik=a→c  (double-underscore separator, matches dir names).
    """
    _edge_map = {"ij": ("id_a", "id_b"), "jk": ("id_b", "id_c"), "ik": ("id_a", "id_c")}
    col_ref, col_sec = _edge_map[edge]
    return f"{row[col_ref]}__{row[col_sec]}"


class TripletTileDataset(Dataset):
    """
    Each item is a spatially-aligned tile from all 3 pairs of a closure triplet.
    Enables the closure loss in run_epoch().

    triplets_df : DataFrame with columns id_ref_ij, id_sec_ij,
                  id_ref_jk, id_sec_jk, id_ref_ik, id_sec_ik
    pair_dir_map: {pair_id -> Path} built from discover_pair_dirs()
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        triplets_df: pd.DataFrame,
        pair_dir_map: Dict[str, Path],
        tile_size: int = 256,
        stride: int = 128,
        min_coherence: float = 0.15,
    ):
        self.tile_size = tile_size
        self.min_coherence = min_coherence
        self.tiles: List[Tuple] = []  # (dir_ij, dir_jk, dir_ik, r, c)

        for _, row in triplets_df.iterrows():
            # Try canonical order first; fall back to reversed (ref/sec swapped)
            _edge_rev = {"ij": ("id_b", "id_a"), "jk": ("id_c", "id_b"), "ik": ("id_c", "id_a")}
            def _lookup(edge):
                key = _pair_key(row, edge)
                if key in pair_dir_map:
                    return pair_dir_map[key]
                cols = _edge_rev[edge]
                rev = f"{row[cols[0]]}__{row[cols[1]]}"
                return pair_dir_map.get(rev)
            dir_ij = _lookup("ij")
            dir_jk = _lookup("jk")
            dir_ik = _lookup("ik")
            if None in (dir_ij, dir_jk, dir_ik):
                continue
            try:
                import rasterio
                with rasterio.open(dir_ij / "ifg_goldstein.tif") as src:
                    H, W = src.height, src.width
            except Exception:
                continue
            T, S = tile_size, stride
            for r in range(0, H - T + 1, S):
                for c in range(0, W - T + 1, S):
                    self.tiles.append((dir_ij, dir_jk, dir_ik, r, c))
            # Cover bottom-right corner
            if H > T:
                for c in range(0, W - T + 1, S):
                    self.tiles.append((dir_ij, dir_jk, dir_ik, H - T, c))
            if W > T:
                for r in range(0, H - T + 1, S):
                    self.tiles.append((dir_ij, dir_jk, dir_ik, r, W - T))

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self.tiles)

    def __getitem__(self, idx: int) -> dict:
        dir_ij, dir_jk, dir_ik, r, c = self.tiles[idx]
        tile_ij = self._load(dir_ij, r, c)
        tile_jk = self._load(dir_jk, r, c)
        tile_ik = self._load(dir_ik, r, c)
        if any(t is None for t in (tile_ij, tile_jk, tile_ik)):
            alt = random.randint(0, len(self.tiles) - 1)
            return self[alt]
        x_ij, gold_ij, phi_ij, coh_ij = tile_ij
        x_jk, gold_jk, phi_jk, _      = tile_jk
        x_ik, gold_ik, phi_ik, _      = tile_ik
        return {
            "x_ij":    torch.from_numpy(x_ij),
            "gold_ij": torch.from_numpy(gold_ij),
            "phi_ij":  torch.from_numpy(phi_ij),
            "x_jk":    torch.from_numpy(x_jk),
            "gold_jk": torch.from_numpy(gold_jk),
            "phi_jk":  torch.from_numpy(phi_jk),
            "x_ik":    torch.from_numpy(x_ik),
            "gold_ik": torch.from_numpy(gold_ik),
            "phi_ik":  torch.from_numpy(phi_ik),
            "coh_ij":  torch.from_numpy(coh_ij),
            "meta_ij": torch.from_numpy(InSARTileDataset._load_meta_static(dir_ij)),
            "meta_jk": torch.from_numpy(InSARTileDataset._load_meta_static(dir_jk)),
            "meta_ik": torch.from_numpy(InSARTileDataset._load_meta_static(dir_ik)),
        }

    def _load(
        self, pair_dir: Path, r: int, c: int
    ) -> Optional[Tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]]:
        """Returns (x, gold, phi, coh) arrays or None if low coherence."""
        import rasterio
        T = self.tile_size
        window = rasterio.windows.Window(c, r, T, T)
        try:
            with rasterio.open(pair_dir / "ifg_goldstein.tif") as src:
                data = src.read(window=window)
            if data.shape[0] == 1:
                cplx = data[0].astype(np.complex64)
                re_gold, im_gold = cplx.real, cplx.imag
            else:
                re_gold = data[0].astype(np.float32)
                im_gold = data[1].astype(np.float32)
            re_gold = np.nan_to_num(re_gold, nan=0.0)
            im_gold = np.nan_to_num(im_gold, nan=0.0)

            raw_path = pair_dir / "ifg_raw.tif"
            if raw_path.exists():
                with rasterio.open(raw_path) as src:
                    raw = src.read(window=window)
                if raw.shape[0] == 1:
                    cplx = raw[0].astype(np.complex64)
                    re_raw, im_raw = cplx.real, cplx.imag
                else:
                    re_raw = raw[0].astype(np.float32)
                    im_raw = raw[1].astype(np.float32)
                re_raw = np.nan_to_num(re_raw, nan=0.0)
                im_raw = np.nan_to_num(im_raw, nan=0.0)
            else:
                re_raw, im_raw = re_gold.copy(), im_gold.copy()

            with rasterio.open(pair_dir / "coherence.tif") as src:
                coh = np.nan_to_num(
                    src.read(1, window=window).astype(np.float32), nan=0.0
                )
        except Exception:
            return None

        if coh.mean() < self.min_coherence:
            return None

        x    = np.stack([re_raw, im_raw, coh], axis=0)          # (3, H, W)
        gold = np.stack([re_gold, im_gold], axis=0)              # (2, H, W)
        phi  = np.arctan2(im_gold, re_gold)[np.newaxis].astype(np.float32)  # (1, H, W)
        return x, gold, phi, coh[np.newaxis]


# ─── data loading helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def discover_pair_dirs(pairs_dir: Path) -> List[Path]:
    """Return all subdirectories of pairs_dir that contain ifg_goldstein.tif."""
    return sorted(
        p for p in pairs_dir.iterdir()
        if p.is_dir() and (p / "ifg_goldstein.tif").exists()
    )


def temporal_split(pair_dirs: List[Path], train_frac: float, val_frac: float):
    """Split pair dirs by date order (encoded in dir name YYYYMMDD_YYYYMMDD)."""
    def _date_key(p: Path) -> str:
        return p.name[:8] if len(p.name) >= 8 else p.name

    sorted_dirs = sorted(pair_dirs, key=_date_key)
    n = len(sorted_dirs)
    n_train = int(n * train_frac)
    n_val = int(n * val_frac)
    return (
        sorted_dirs[:n_train],
        sorted_dirs[n_train:n_train + n_val],
        sorted_dirs[n_train + n_val:],
    )


# ─── checkpoint helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def save_checkpoint(
    path: Path,
    model: nn.Module,
    optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer,
    epoch: int,
    metrics: dict,
    configs: dict,
) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    torch.save(
        {
            "epoch": epoch,
            "model_state": model.state_dict(),
            "optimizer_state": optimizer.state_dict(),
            "metrics": metrics,
            "configs": configs,
            "git_hash": git_hash(),
        },
        path,
    )


# ─── training / validation loops ─────────────────────────────────────────────

def run_epoch(
    model: FiLMUNet,
    loader: DataLoader,
    criterion: InSARLoss,
    optimizer: Optional[torch.optim.Optimizer],
    device: torch.device,
    grad_clip: float = 1.0,
    zero_metadata: bool = False,
    triplet_loader: Optional[DataLoader] = None,
) -> dict:
    training = optimizer is not None
    model.train(training)
    totals: Dict[str, float] = {}
    n = 0

    # Prepare triplet iterator (cycles over triplet batches in lock-step with main loader)
    _triplet_iter = iter(triplet_loader) if (triplet_loader is not None and training) else None

    with torch.set_grad_enabled(training):
        for batch in loader:
            x    = batch["x"].float().to(device)          # (B, C, H, W) — raw (noisy)
            gold = batch["gold"].float().to(device)        # (B, 2, H, W) — Goldstein (pseudo-clean)
            meta = batch["metadata"].float().to(device)
            if zero_metadata:
                meta = torch.zeros_like(meta)              # ablation V5: no FiLM conditioning

            denoised, log_var = model(x, meta)

            inp = PhysicsLossInputs(
                pred_a=denoised,      # model prediction on raw input
                sublook_b=gold,       # Goldstein as N2N target
                log_var=log_var,
                full_look=gold,       # gradient loss: model output vs Goldstein
            )
            loss, breakdown = criterion(inp)

            if training:
                optimizer.zero_grad()
                loss.backward()
                nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), grad_clip)
                optimizer.step()

            for k, v in breakdown.items():
                totals[k] = totals.get(k, 0.0) + v
            n += 1

            # ── Closure loss from triplet batch ──────────────────────────────
            if _triplet_iter is not None:
                try:
                    tri = next(_triplet_iter)
                except StopIteration:
                    _triplet_iter = iter(triplet_loader)
                    tri = next(_triplet_iter)

                x_ij = tri["x_ij"].float().to(device)
                x_jk = tri["x_jk"].float().to(device)
                x_ik = tri["x_ik"].float().to(device)
                if zero_metadata:
                    m_ij = torch.zeros(x_ij.shape[0], 7, device=device)
                    m_jk = torch.zeros_like(m_ij)
                    m_ik = torch.zeros_like(m_ij)
                else:
                    m_ij = tri["meta_ij"].float().to(device)
                    m_jk = tri["meta_jk"].float().to(device)
                    m_ik = tri["meta_ik"].float().to(device)

                d_ij, lv_ij = model(x_ij, m_ij)
                d_jk, _     = model(x_jk, m_jk)
                d_ik, _     = model(x_ik, m_ik)

                phi_ij = torch.atan2(d_ij[:, 1], d_ij[:, 0])  # (B, H, W)
                phi_jk = torch.atan2(d_jk[:, 1], d_jk[:, 0])
                phi_ik = torch.atan2(d_ik[:, 1], d_ik[:, 0])

                clos_inp = PhysicsLossInputs(
                    pred_a=d_ij,
                    sublook_b=tri["gold_ij"].float().to(device),
                    log_var=lv_ij,
                    full_look=tri["gold_ij"].float().to(device),
                    phi_ij=phi_ij,
                    phi_jk=phi_jk,
                    phi_ik=phi_ik,
                    closure_weight=tri["coh_ij"].float().to(device).squeeze(1),
                )
                clos_loss, clos_breakdown = criterion(clos_inp)

                optimizer.zero_grad()
                clos_loss.backward()
                nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), grad_clip)
                optimizer.step()

                for k, v in clos_breakdown.items():
                    totals[f"tri_{k}"] = totals.get(f"tri_{k}", 0.0) + float(v)

    return {k: v / max(n, 1) for k, v in totals.items()}
